basic_profile.bio: I'm a huge sports enthusiast based in San Francisco, currently exploring the world of Reddit to catch up on all things 49ers. I'm a recent college graduate working in a local sports shop, with a passion for football and gaming. Not a fan of early mornings, so you'll usually find me online late at night. Trying to balance my love for sports with a budding interest in interior design. Single and ready to mingle, but my true love remains the Niners.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I grew up in a sports-loving family, which led to a deep interest in football. Most of my knowledge comes from watching games, listening to sports podcasts, and reading articles. Recently, I've started diving into draft analysis to better understand player potential and team strategy.
